title: Effects of Anorexia Nervosa on Bone Mass in Adolescents
brief_summary: This study is to determine the effects of anorexia nervosa on bone mass and hormone levels in adolescents. Whether administration of estrogen, a normal hormone present during puberty, can help maintain bone development in girls with anorexia nervosa will be determined.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Females Only with Anorexia Nervosa and Amenorrhea 12-18 years
* Normal-weight girls 12-18 years with no past or present history of an eating disorder

Exclusion Criteria:

* Diseases affecting bone metabolism (including untreated thyroid disease, premature ovarian failure, diabetes, cancer, pituitary, renal disease or bone fracture within the past six months)
* Use of prescription medications affecting bone metabolism within three months
* Suicidality
* Psychosis
* Substance abuse
* Hematocrit \<30 %
* Potassium \<3.0 mmol/L
* Glucose \<50 mg/dl.
